description.full:
We are looking for an experienced OCI Security Specialist to design and implement a comprehensive security posture across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) tenancies. The role focuses on protecting workloads, data, networks, and identities in line with enterprise security policies and regulatory requirements and embedding security across cloud and hybrid environments. The specialist will collaborate with cloud architects, network and DevOps teams, compliance officers, and application teams to drive DevSecOps practices and compliance.

Responsibilities
  • Architect and implement end-to-end security frameworks for OCI tenancies aligned with CIS OCI Foundations Benchmark, NIST CSF, and ISO 27001.
  • Design multi-layer security architectures including perimeter security, network security, workload security, data security, and identity security.
  • Conduct cloud security architecture reviews and threat modeling for OCI-hosted applications and infrastructure.
  • Define and enforce security baselines, guardrails, and security landing zones for OCI environments.
  • Evaluate and recommend OCI-native and third-party security tools and services.

Identity & Access Management (IAM):

  • Design and implement OCI IAM policies, Compartments, Groups, Dynamic Groups, and Federation (SAML, SCIM, LDAP) for enterprise-grade access governance.
  • Implement Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) across OCI resources.
  • Manage OCI Identity Domains, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Privileged Access Management (PAM) integrations.
  • Conduct periodic IAM access reviews and entitlement certifications.
  • Implement service account and API key lifecycle management for OCI resources.

Data Security & Encryption:

  • Design and implement data encryption strategies for data at rest and data in transit across OCI services.
  • Manage OCI Vault (Key Management Service) for customer-managed encryption keys (CMEKs), secrets, and certificates.
  • Implement OCI Data Safe for Oracle Database security assessment, data masking, and sensitive data discovery.
  • Configure and manage OCI Object Storage encryption, Block Volume encryption, and Database encryption.
  • Define and enforce data classification and data handling policies on OCI.

Network Security:

  • Design and implement network security controls using OCI Network Firewall, Web Application Firewall (WAF), Security Lists, and Network Security Groups (NSGs).
  • Configure OCI DDoS protection, rate limiting, and traffic scrubbing for internet-facing workloads.
  • Implement Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) principles on OCI.
  • Monitor and analyze VCN Flow Logs, Firewall logs, and WAF logs for threat detection.
  • Conduct network security assessments and penetration testing coordination.

Threat Detection, Monitoring & Incident Response:

  • Implement and manage OCI Cloud Guard for continuous security posture monitoring, threat detection, and automated remediation.
  • Configure OCI Security Zones and Security Advisor to enforce security policies at the compartment level.
  • Integrate OCI Logging, OCI Logging Analytics, and OCI Events with SIEM platforms (Splunk, IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel) for centralized security monitoring.
  • Define and respond to security incidents including investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery.
  • Develop and maintain Incident Response (IR) plans, playbooks, and runbooks for OCI environments.
  • Conduct regular threat hunting and vulnerability management activities.

Vulnerability Management & Compliance:

  • Conduct security assessments, vulnerability scans, and CIS benchmark compliance checks across OCI environments.
  • Manage and track remediation of vulnerabilities identified in OCI workloads and infrastructure.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory standards including PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 on OCI.
  • Leverage OCI Compliance Documents and perform audit evidence collection for security certifications.
  • Implement and manage OCI Audit Service for comprehensive activity logging and forensic readiness.

DevSecOps & Automation:

  • Embed security controls into CI/CD pipelines (shift-left security) including SAST, DAST, SCA, and container image scanning.
  • Automate security policy enforcement and compliance checks using Terraform, OCI CLI, and custom Python/Bash scripts.
  • Implement OCI Functions for automated security response and remediation.
  • Develop security-as-code policies using OPA (Open Policy Agent) or equivalent frameworks.
  • Manage secure configuration baselines using Ansible and OCI OS Management Service.
  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement:
  • Provide security advisory and consultation to project teams during design and implementation phases.
  • Conduct security awareness sessions and training for cloud operations and development teams.
  • Engage with Oracle security teams, third-party auditors, and regulatory bodies as required.
  • Mentor junior security engineers and contribute to security capability building within the organization.
  • Prepare security reports, dashboards, and executive summaries for leadership and clients.
Requirements
Mandatory
  • We are seeking a highly experienced OCI Security Specialist with 7 to 11 years of expertise in cloud security architecture, implementation, and operations on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • Deep expertise in OCI IAM (Policies, Compartments, Domains, Federation, Dynamic Groups, Service Principals).
  • Hands-on experience with OCI Cloud Guard, Security Zones, Security Advisor, and Threat Intelligence.
  • Proficiency in OCI Vault (Key Management), OCI Certificates, and OCI Data Safe.
  • Strong knowledge of OCI Network Firewall, WAF, VCN Flow Logs, and DDoS Protection.
  • Experience with OCI Audit Service, OCI Logging, OCI Logging Analytics, and OCI Events.
  • Familiarity with OCI Bastion Service, OCI Web Application Firewall, and OCI Identity Domains.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security frameworks: CIS OCI Benchmark, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CSA CCM.
  • Expertise in encryption standards (AES-256, TLS 1.2/1.3, RSA, ECC) and PKI management.
  • Deep knowledge of IAM concepts including RBAC, ABAC, PoLP, PAM, and Zero Trust.
  • Experience with threat modeling methodologies (STRIDE, PASTA, DREAD).
  • Proficiency in vulnerability management tools (Qualys, Nessus, Rapid7, or equivalent).
  • Knowledge of penetration testing concepts and coordination with external pen test teams.
  • Experience with SIEM platforms (Splunk, QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, or equivalent) for log ingestion and correlation.
  • Hands-on experience with Incident Response (IR) processes and security playbook development.
  • Knowledge of compliance frameworks: PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and DPDP Act.
  • Experience with GRC tools and security risk management frameworks.
  • Proficiency in Python, Ansible, Bash scripting for security automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform for security infrastructure as code.
  • Familiarity with OCI CLI and OCI SDKs for security operations.
  • Experience with DevSecOps tools: SonarQube, Trivy, Checkmarx, Aqua Security, or Prisma Cloud.
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2024/25 Security Professional Certification (OCI Security Professional)
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2024/25 Foundations Associate (OCI Foundations Associate)
Nice-to-have
  • Experience with Oracle Database Security including TDE, Database Vault, Label Security, and Audit Vault.
  • Knowledge of OCI Data Science and AI/ML security considerations.
  • Familiarity with container security and Kubernetes security (OKE RBAC, Pod Security, Network Policies).
  • Exposure to CASB (Cloud Access Security Broker) solutions.
  • Understanding of OCI Observability and Monitoring for security performance baselines.
  • Knowledge of cloud forensics and digital evidence collection techniques.
  • Experience with phishing simulation, security awareness, and training program management.
  • Familiarity with Oracle CASB Cloud Service and Oracle Security Monitoring and Analytics.
  • Understanding of supply chain security and software composition analysis (SCA).
  • Knowledge of multi-cloud security architecture (OCI + AWS, OCI + Azure) and cross-cloud governance.
  • Exposure to OCI Government Cloud and sovereign cloud security requirements.
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2024/25 Architect Associate / OCI Architect Professional
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) (Highly Preferred)
  • Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) - (ISC)2 (Highly Preferred)

  • Monitor infrastructure capacity, utilization, and scalability requirements.
  • Develop infrastructure roadmaps aligned with business objectives.

Security Operations Center (SOC) Management

  • Lead and manage day-to-day SOC operations, including monitoring, detection, analysis, and response activities.
  • Oversee Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, or LogRhythm.
  • Establish and maintain security monitoring use cases, alert tuning, and threat detection capabilities.
  • Ensure timely investigation, containment, and remediation of security incidents.
  • Coordinate incident response activities and post-incident reviews.
  • Develop and maintain SOC processes, playbooks, and operational procedures.
  • Lead threat hunting and vulnerability management initiatives.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management

  • Collaborate with security teams to strengthen organizational security posture.
  • Ensure compliance with security standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls, SOC 2, and GDPR.
  • Conduct risk assessments and security reviews of infrastructure environments.
  • Manage vulnerability assessments, penetration testing remediation, and patch management programs.
  • Implement security controls across cloud, network, and endpoint environments.

Cloud & Platform Administration

  • Manage Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud infrastructure environments.
  • Lead cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
  • Implement cloud security best practices and governance controls.
  • Drive infrastructure automation through Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, or similar tools.

Network & Data Center Operations

  • Oversee LAN, WAN, VPN, SD-WAN, firewalls, IDS/IPS, and load balancer environments.
  • Ensure secure network architecture and segmentation.
  • Support business continuity, disaster recovery, and backup strategies.

Incident Response & Business Continuity

  • Serve as the escalation point for critical infrastructure and cybersecurity incidents.
  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and drive corrective actions.
  • Develop, test, and maintain Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Plans (BCP).
  • Ensure rapid recovery and minimal business disruption during outages or security events.

People Leadership

  • Lead Infrastructure Engineers, System Administrators, Network Engineers, Security Analysts, and SOC Engineers.
  • Mentor and develop team members through training, coaching, and career planning.
  • Establish team goals, KPIs, and operational excellence standards.
  • Foster a culture of security awareness and continuous improvement.

Project & Vendor Management

  • Deliver infrastructure and cybersecurity projects within scope, budget, and timelines.
  • Manage technology vendors, managed security service providers (MSSPs), and infrastructure partners.
  • Participate in annual budgeting, forecasting, and capacity planning.

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience in Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and virtualization technologies.
  • Expertise in Azure, AWS, or GCP environments.
  • Experience with SIEM platforms (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, LogRhythm).
  • Knowledge of EDR/XDR solutions such as Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or Cortex.

  • Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or Terraform.

Leadership Skills

  • Experience leading both Infrastructure and Cybersecurity/SOC teams.
  • Strong communication, decision-making, and crisis management skills.

DESCRIPTION

Bounteous is a leading digital innovation partner for the worlds most ambitious brands. Our organization creates transformative digital experiences through services that include strategy, experience design, technology, analytics and insight, and marketing.

Our Managed Services team is looking for a Security Engineer, to join our growing Cloud Engineering & Security team. This role will work closely with department team members, Principal Architects, and leaders from other disciplines to support key security initiatives and the continued development of solutions for improving security standards, baselines, policies, and procedures for clients.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Partner with leads and architects to create security solutions for proof of concepts, new integrations, and other technical service offerings.

  • Manage and maintain security tools and technologies, such as SIEM systems, IDS/IPS, and endpoint security.

  • Programming/scripting skills (Python, JavaScript, Go, etc.)
  • Knowledge of cloud architecture and security (nice to have).
  • Ability to learn new skills, concepts, and technologies
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, ability to communicate vulnerabilities to a variety of stakeholders
  • Strong understanding of fundamental computing, database, networking, and security concepts
  • Considerable Experience with Cloudflare Security Products & Features (Cloudflare ACE Certification preferred)
  • Good communication skills and ability to remain calm and work under pressure.

Role Summary

We are hiring a Senior AI / Python Engineer for one of the AI Initiative, which delivers an enterprise MCP (Model Context Protocol) platform connecting ChatGPT Enterprise to governed data in Databricks Unity Catalog. You will design and build core platform components, including the orchestration layer, account and entity resolution, and observability. You will also enhance the MCP server, engineer and evaluate prompts and agent instructions, enable new features, and own upgrades, releases, and production quality.


Key Responsibilities

Platform development

  • Design and build the multi-agent orchestration layer: intent classification, semantic routing (embedding similarity with LLM fallback), agent handoffs, and clarification flows.
  • Build and evolve account and entity resolution: alias indexes, fuzzy and semantic matching, batch index publishing with versioned swaps, and shadow-to-enforce rollouts, delivered as versioned, tested Python packages.
  • Enhance the MCP server (FastMCP): tools, agents, and new features from requirements through release.
  • Write design documents before coding and document trade-offs across accuracy, latency, and cost.

Prompt engineering and agent configuration

  • Develop and refine prompts, agent instructions, tool descriptions, and semantic examples; reduce hallucination and tool-selection errors.
  • Onboard and maintain agents: configuration, vector stores and recipe files, retrieval tuning, and SQL logic against Databricks Unity Catalog.

Observability, evaluation, and quality

  • Instrument agents and tools with Langfuse (or equivalent) tracing; track prompt versions, token cost, latency, and quality per agent.
  • Maintain evaluation suites (e.g., Promptfoo) with LLM-as-judge grading; add regression tests for every prompt or agent change and gate releases on the results.
  • Own the audit and activity pipeline (CloudWatch, S3, Databricks); use logs, traces, and user feedback to improve routing, prompts, and retrieval.

Platform lifecycle and operations

  • Plan and run dependency upgrades (OpenAI Agents SDK, openai, pydantic, FastMCP): breaking-change analysis, compatibility testing, phased rollout, and rollback.
  • Manage CI/CD (GitHub Actions), nonprod-to-prod promotion, configuration and secrets, and Kubernetes (EKS) rollouts.
  • Integrate external services and MCPs (e.g., Salesforce/MuleSoft, APISIX-based MCPs).
  • Triage and resolve production issues; write and maintain runbooks.

Scale, security, and governance

  • Optimize performance and cost: concurrency, rate limiting, connection pooling, Redis caching, retries and timeouts, model selection, token usage, and multi-pod consistency.
  • Implement enterprise controls: OAuth (Azure AD) with user impersonation (OBO), row-level security compatibility, input validation, prompt-injection defenses, PII handling, and audit logging.

Collaboration

  • Work with the OpenAI team, AWS/EKS infrastructure, security owners, and business users.
  • Use AI-assisted development and review tools while owning design decisions and verifying every change with tests.

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong Python (3.10+): async programming, typing, packaging, and testing (pytest).
  • Hands-on experience building LLM applications: prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and multi-agent or orchestration design.
  • Proven ownership of a production system component (e.g., orchestration, routing, matching, or search) from design through operations.
  • Experience with entity matching, NLP, or retrieval (fuzzy matching, embeddings, RAG).
  • API and security fundamentals: REST, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC.
  • Working knowledge of AWS (EKS, S3, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, Redis/ElastiCache), Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Strong SQL and a cloud data platform (Databricks or similar), including notebooks/PySpark.
  • Git and CI/CD (GitHub Actions); track record of managing breaking dependency upgrades safely.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to work independently in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), FastMCP, OpenAI Agents SDK, or comparable agent frameworks (LangChain / LangGraph).
  • Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tools (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Promptfoo).
  • Familiarity with Databricks Unity Catalog governance, row/column-level security, and metric views or semantic layers.
  • Background in enterprise security: Azure AD / Entra ID, identity propagation, secrets management.
  • Experience optimizing cost and latency of LLM workloads.
  • Life sciences, commercial, or enterprise data domain experience.

Technology Stack

Python 3.11 • FastMCP • OpenAI Agents SDK / ChatGPT Enterprise • Databricks Unity Catalog • AWS (EKS, CloudWatch, S3, DynamoDB, Redis, ALB, WAF) • Azure AD OAuth • Langfuse • Promptfoo • GitHub Actions • Docker / Kubernetes

About the Role

We are looking for a Project Engineer/Migration Specialist to deliver Microsoft 365, identity, and migration projects for our clients. This is hands-on cloud engineering, not advisory work: you build and harden tenants, untangle hybrid identity, manage devices through Intune, and move mail, files, and users between platforms without losing data or a weekend.

You will work across many client tenants at once, typically with two to five projects running in parallel at different stages. Each project is yours to execute discovery, build, pilot, cutover, handover with a senior engineer available for architecture calls.

The experience bar

  • 5-10 years in IT overall, with at least 2 years administering Microsoft 365 and Entra IDacross more than one organization or tenant.
  • At least five migrations you personally executed mailbox, tenant-to-tenant, file, or Active Directory domain with the tooling you used named.
  • You own the technical execution and escalate architecture decisions. You are not expected to design a client's identity strategy from scratch; you are expected to implement one correctly and spot when it is wrong.

What you'll do

Migrations

  • Run mailbox, tenant, file, and domain migrations end to end using various migration tools discovery, pilot group, cutover plan, cutover, post-cutover support.
  • Agree rollback criteria and a downtime window with the client before the window opens, and hold to them.
  • Reconcile what actually moved against what was supposed to move, and chase the difference.

Microsoft 365 and Entra ID

  • Run mailbox, tenant, file, and domain migrations end to end using various migration tools — discovery, pilot group, cutover plan, cutover, post-cutover support.
  • Agree rollback criteria and a downtime window with the client before the window opens and hold to them.
  • Reconcile what moved against what was supposed to move and chase the difference.

Azure and endpoints

  • Deploy and maintain Azure infrastructure: VMs, virtual networks, NSGs, site-to-site VPN, Azure Files, Azure Backup, and Azure Virtual Desktop where clients use it.
  • Manage client devices through Intune: Autopilot enrolment, compliance and configuration profiles, app packaging and deployment, BitLocker and Defender policy, update rings.

Delivery and handover

  • Write the as-built documentation into IT Glue and brief the service desk, so nothing undocumented is left behind.
  • Keep project time and status current in the PSA so account managers can see where things stand.
  • Join client calls to explain what is changing, what will briefly break, and when.

Required qualifications

All four of the pillars below are required. Within each, you should be able to do most of what is listed without supervision.

1. Microsoft 365 administration

  • Exchange Online: mail flow, connectors, transport rules, shared and resource mailboxes, mailbox delegation, message trace, retention basics
  • Mail DNS: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Autodiscover, and what TTL does to a cutover
  • SharePoint Online and OneDrive: site and library creation, permission inheritance, sharing policies, sync troubleshooting
  • Microsoft Teams: provisioning, guest access, and how Teams relates to the SharePoint site behind it
  • Microsoft 365 admin center, license assignment, and group-based licensing

2. Entra ID (formerly Azure AD)

  • Users, groups, dynamic groups, administrative roles and units
  • Entra Connect Sync or Cloud Sync: installation, OU and attribute filtering, and resolving sync errors
  • Hybrid join versus Entra join, and when each applies
  • Conditional Access policy design, MFA rollout, SSPR, and why security defaults are not enough
  • Enterprise applications and SAML or OIDC single sign-on

3. Azure

  • Virtual machines, virtual networks, NSGs, public IPs, site-to-site VPN
  • Azure Files with AD DS or Entra authentication; Azure Virtual Desktop basics
  • Azure Backup and Recovery Services vaults
  • Subscriptions, resource groups, RBAC, and enough cost management to not surprise a client

4. Intune

  • Enrollment: Windows Autopilot, co-management, BYOD, Apple and Android enrollment
  • Compliance policies, configuration profiles, and the Settings Catalog
  • App deployment: Win32 packaging (.intunewin), Store apps, and line-of-business apps
  • BitLocker policy and Defender for Endpoint onboarding
  • Update rings and Windows Update for Business

5. Migration delivery— demonstrable experience in at least two of:

  • On-premises Exchange to Exchange Online: cutover, staged, or hybrid using the Hybrid Configuration Wizard
  • Tenant-to-tenant migration following an acquisition, divestiture, or rebrand
  • Google Workspace or IMAP to Microsoft 365
  • File server or NAS to SharePoint Online, OneDrive, or Teams
  • Active Directory domain migration or consolidation: ADMT, SID history, forest trusts, UPN suffix change, workstation re-domain
  • Another MDM platform into Intune

6. Windows Server and AD DS

  • Active Directory Domain Services, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, file and print services
  • Hyper-V setup and configuration

7. PowerShell

  • Bulk operations against Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph, and Entra
  • You read and modify scripts rather than only running ones you found

8. Working style

  • Experience working on a fully remote team.
  • Client-facing: comfortable explaining a downtime window to a non-technical stakeholder.
  • Documentation discipline — across many tenants, undocumented work is lost work.
  • Available for scheduled after-hours and weekend cutover windows.
  • Prior MSP or multi-client experience.

Required qualifications

  • Security and compliance:Microsoft Purview (DLP, retention, sensitivity labels, eDiscovery), Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, Secure Score remediation, CIS benchmarks, HIPAA or CMMC-adjacent client work
  • Privileged identity:Privileged Identity Management, access reviews, entitlement management
  • Automation:Power Automate, Power Apps, Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Graph API scripting beyond cmdlets

Helpful Qualifications

  • Microsoft 365 backup and BCDR:Veeam, Datto, Dropsuite, Afi, Acronis, Keepit
  • Hypervisors:VMware ESXi, Nutanix Acropolis
  • Other platforms:AWS, Google Workspace administration, Egnyte, Citrix ShareFile, Cloudflare, QuickBooks Online
  • Apple ecosystem:macOS and iOS deployment, Apple Business Manager, Jamf, Mosyle, or Intune for Mac
  • Network and edge:SonicWall and Fortinet firewalls, Cisco Meraki and Ubiquiti wireless, Cisco and Dell switching
  • Storage:QNAP, Synology, and Dell NAS, particularly as a migration source
  • MSP tooling:ConnectWise Manage and Automate, Sention, Autotask, Kaseya, NinjaOne, Datto RMM, IT Glue, Hudu; multi-tenant M365 administration tools such as Nerdio, inforcer, CIPP; password management such as Keeper; M365 migration tools such as BitTitan.

Certifications

At least one current Microsoft role-based certification, or demonstrable equivalent experience. Examples:

  • MS-102- Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert
  • SC-300- Identity and Access Administrator
  • MD-102- Endpoint Administrator
  • AZ-104- Azure Administrator Associate
  • AZ-800 / AZ-801- Windows Server Hybrid Administrator
  • MS-700- Teams Administrator
  • SC-200- Security Operations Analyst
